edges.reason: Owner state variable is assigned directly from attacker-controlled msg.sender in the constructor.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions.
onlyVerifierManager compares msg.sender against verifierManager (or owner if unset).
onlyFeeManager compares msg.sender against feeManager (or owner if unset).
onlyVerifier validates msg.sender through isVerifier.
msg.sender is pushed into the withdrawal approval list and gates execution via onlyVerifier.
msg.sender is appended to withdrawalApprovals, determining when the approval threshold is met.
msg.sender is appended to anchorApprovals, determining when the anchor threshold is met.
setVerifierManager is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
setFeeManager is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
addVerifier is protected by the onlyVerifierManager modifier.
removeVerifier is protected by the onlyVerifierManager modifier.
setNctEthExchangeRate is protected by the onlyFeeManager modifier.
approveWithdrawal is protected by the onlyVerifier modifier.
unapproveWithdrawal is protected by the onlyVerifier modifier.
anchor is protected by the onlyVerifier modifier.
unanchor is protected by the onlyVerifier modifier.
onlyVerifier delegates authorization to isVerifier(msg.sender).
isVerifier reads verifierAddressToIndex to validate the caller.
isVerifier cross-checks the verifiers array entry for the stored index.
Constructor initializes verifierManager to address(0), making onlyVerifierManager fall back to onlyOwner.
Constructor initializes feeManager to address(0), making onlyFeeManager fall back to onlyOwner.
Constructor pushes the dummy and provided verifiers into the verifiers array.
Constructor populates verifierAddressToIndex for each provided verifier.
Constructor sets requiredVerifiers from calculateRequiredVerifiers.
Constructor stores the initial NCT/ETH exchange rate.
Constructor stores the initially computed fees.
Constructor stores the ERC20 token reference.
Constructor stores the fee wallet address.
Constructor calls calculateRequiredVerifiers to derive the threshold.
Constructor calls calculateFees to derive the initial fee.
Constructor uses SafeMath.add (i.add(1)) when indexing verifiers.
setVerifierManager overwrites the verifierManager state variable.
setFeeManager overwrites the feeManager state variable.
addVerifier pushes the new verifier onto the verifiers array.
addVerifier records the new verifier index in verifierAddressToIndex.
addVerifier recomputes requiredVerifiers after adding a verifier.
addVerifier recomputes fees after adding a verifier.
addVerifier calls calculateRequiredVerifiers.
addVerifier calls calculateFees.
addVerifier uses SafeMath.sub on the push index.
addVerifier uses SafeMath.add for the 1-based index.
removeVerifier swaps and shrinks the verifiers array.
removeVerifier updates verifierAddressToIndex for the swapped and deleted entries.
removeVerifier recomputes requiredVerifiers.
removeVerifier recomputes fees.
removeVerifier calls calculateRequiredVerifiers.
removeVerifier calls calculateFees.
removeVerifier performs several SafeMath.sub operations on the verifier count and index.
activeVerifiers copies the verifiers array excluding the dummy entry.
activeVerifiers uses SafeMath.sub to size and index the return array.
numberOfVerifiers reads verifiers.length.
numberOfVerifiers subtracts the dummy verifier via SafeMath.sub.
calculateRequiredVerifiers consumes the verifier count.
calculateRequiredVerifiers multiplies the verifier count by 2 via SafeMath.mul.
calculateRequiredVerifiers divides by 3 via SafeMath.div.
setNctEthExchangeRate overwrites the exchange rate state variable.
setNctEthExchangeRate stores the recomputed fees.
setNctEthExchangeRate calls calculateFees.
calculateFees uses the number of verifiers for the gas estimate.
calculateFees multiplies gas estimates by SafeMath.mul.
calculateFees adds the per-withdrawal gas via SafeMath.add.
approveWithdrawal creates and updates the Withdrawal struct, including the processed flag.
approveWithdrawal pushes the caller into withdrawalApprovals.
approveWithdrawal computes net = amount.sub(fees) using SafeMath.sub.
approveWithdrawal performs an external token transfer to the fee wallet before marking the withdrawal processed.
approveWithdrawal performs an external token transfer to the destination before marking the withdrawal processed.
A malicious ERC20 fee transfer can re-enter approveWithdrawal before w.processed is set, allowing repeated approvals/transfers.
A malicious ERC20 destination transfer can re-enter approveWithdrawal before w.processed is set, allowing repeated transfers.
unapproveWithdrawal removes the caller from the withdrawal approval list.
unapproveWithdrawal uses SafeMath.sub for swap-remove indexing and array length.
anchor appends or updates Anchor structs and their processed flag.
anchor pushes the caller into anchorApprovals.
anchor uses SafeMath.sub to index the last anchor and array length.
unanchor removes the caller from the anchor approval list.
unanchor uses SafeMath.sub for swap-remove indexing and array length.
renounceOwnership resets the owner state variable to address(0).
transferOwnership delegates to the internal _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with the new owner.
SafeMath.mul performs the raw multiplication that can overflow before the assertion.
SafeMath.sub performs the raw subtraction guarded by an underflow assertion.
SafeMath.add performs the raw addition guarded by an overflow assertion.
